result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: it is mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, runs for 12 months from each person's end of involvement, includes general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and expressly avoids a no-hire restriction. The changes are appropriately confined to narrowing and mutualizing the original restriction. Drafting is professional, although “responses to them” has a slightly unclear antecedent and could be clarified. The unsupported reference to Section 12.3 in the margin comment does not affect the operative result.
